30. `layout_notes` destroying the DOM on each single note change.

🔴 While working on note_4_onclick_check, I started to replace
the systematic call to `layout_notes` after every single change.

The result is a rebuilt `saved_notes_TABLE.innerHTML` from scratch.
As a consequence, all notes classList style adjustments that were made
are lost on each call.

This was acceptable during the early stages of developpement but not anymore.


In this case, updating the `note.checked` attribute
could be easily replaced in `note_4_onclick_check` with this:

``` javascript

    // SYNC CHECKED TR STYLE ● @see [layout_notes] (populating saved_notes_TABLE TR)
    e.target.closest("TR")
        .className
        = "node_row "
        +  get_checked(index)
        +  (nArray[index].text.includes(AUTO_SAVE_TAG) ? " auto_save":"");
```
